{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect basic info
df.info()
print('\nFirst few rows:\n', df.head(3))

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print('\nNumber of -999 in biomarker_baseline:', (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check for duplicate patient_ids
print('\nNumber of duplicate patient_id entries:', df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check assay_batch values
print('\nUnique assay_batch values:', df['assay_batch'].unique())

# Check if biomarker_final has any -999 or other invalid values
print('\nNumber of -999 in biomarker_final:', (df['biomarker_final'] == -999).sum())

# Check for missing values in biomarker_final
print('\nMissing values in biomarker_final:', df['biomarker_final'].isnull().sum())"}
